name: Bulk Variation Editing For WooCommerce
author: ithemelandco

sections.description:
Do you sell products with different sizes, colors, or other options? You know how incredibly time-consuming it is to update prices, stock, and images for every single variation. The Bulk Variation Editing for WooCommerce Plugin is designed to solve this exact problem.

Our plugin provides a powerful, spreadsheet-style interface to filter, search, and modify thousands of product variations at once. Stop opening endless product pages and start managing your variable products with speed and efficiency. Take back your time and focus on growing your business.

⭐ WHAT YOU CAN DO WITH THE FREE VERSION ⭐

The free version provides the essential tools you need to start managing your variations more effectively.

  • ✅ View All Variations: See all your product variations from across your entire catalog in one single, powerful table.
  • ✅ Advanced Filtering: Find the exact variations you need to edit by filtering by product title, SKU, attributes, and more.
  • ✅ Bulk Edit Stock: Instantly update the stock quantity and stock status for thousands of variations at once.
  • ✅ Simple Price Editing: Quickly set a new Regular Price or Sale Price for your filtered variations.

🚀 BECOME A VARIATION MANAGEMENT EXPERT WITH PRO 🚀

Upgrade to the Pro Version to unlock the ultimate toolkit for managing variable products.

  • 🎯 Edit ANY Variation Field: Get unlimited access to bulk edit every field, including price, stock, weight, dimensions, shipping class, tax class, attributes, and even the variation image.
  • 🔄 Undo / Redo & History: Never worry about mistakes again. View a complete history of all changes and revert any operation with a single click.
  • ➕ Advanced Bulk Price Updates: Apply complex price changes. Increase or decrease prices by a percentage (%) or a fixed dollar amount ($), and even round to the nearest value.
  • ✍️ Append, Prepend, & Replace Text: Easily add text to the beginning or end of SKUs and other text fields in bulk.
  • 💾 Save Your Filters: Save your complex search queries to reuse them later for recurring tasks.
  • 🗑️ Bulk Delete Variations: Clean up your store by bulk deleting old or unnecessary variations based on your filters.

See all the powerful Pro features and save hours of work!

Explore our full range of powerful WordPress plugins on the official iThemelandCo website.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ithemeland-bulk-variation-editing-for-woocommerce directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. After installation, a new “iT Woo Variation” menu will be added to your admin dashboard.
sections.faq:
How is this different from editing variations within a product?

The standard WooCommerce interface requires you to open each product individually and then edit variations one by one. Our plugin lets you see and edit ALL variations from ALL products on a single screen, turning a task that could take hours into one that takes minutes.

Can I update the price of all “Large” variations across my store?

Yes! You can use the advanced filter to find all variations with the “Large” attribute and then use the bulk edit form to update their price, stock, or any other field all at once.

What happens if I make a mistake while editing?

The Pro version includes a comprehensive History tab that tracks every single bulk operation. If you make a mistake, you can simply find the action in the history and click “Undo” to revert the changes instantly.

Can I see a live demo before I decide?

Absolutely. We highly recommend you try the full power of the Pro version on our live demo site.
